{{Quote|I am Lieutenant Dorss, customs. This is Sergeant Vult. He will conduct a brief inspection of your craft. Are all compartments accessible?''"<br />"''They are.|Dorss and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="OC" />}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Dorss''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Customs official/Legends|customs officer]] stationed at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Dor'shan/Legends|Dor'shan]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. When recently [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], traveled to Dorin to speak with [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Master]] [[Koro Ziil]] of the [[Baran Do]]&mdash;an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] who lived on the planet&mdash;in hopes of finding out more about former Jedi Knight [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and transformation into [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus, Dorss, along with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Vult]], inspected the Jedi's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Purpose of visit to Dorin?''"<br />"''Research. We seek an audience with the Baran Do Sages.''"<br />"''Information brokerage, then?''"<br />"''I don't think so. I didn't plan to offer my credits for the information I'm looking for. Nor would I charge any for information I provide.''"<br />"''No trade goods? ''[Luke and Ben shake their heads]'' Tourism, then. Will you require accommodations?''"<br />"''No, for convenience's sake, we'll be keeping quarters aboard the yacht.|Dorss and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="OC" />}}
[[File:Dorin-FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|Dorss worked as a customs officer on the planet Dorin (pictured).]]
Dorss was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who lived on the<ref name="OC" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="OC" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', the first installment of the series, must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> Dorss served as a Dorin [[Customs official/Legends|customs officer]] with the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the recently [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], together with his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], visited Dorin to speak with [[Koro Ziil]], the [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Master]] of the [[Baran Do]] order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]], to find out why former Jedi Knight [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and transformed into the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus.<ref name="OC" />

After the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]] landed their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in Dorin's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Dor'shan/Legends|Dor'shan]], Dorss&mdash;together with his partner, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Vult]]&mdash;greeted the Jedi and informed them that Vult would perform a short inspection of their ship. In the meantime, Dorss questioned Luke Skywalker on the purpose of the Jedi's visit, initially suggesting that by meeting with the Baran Do they were taking part in information brokering, before concluding that they came as "tourists" when Luke insisted they weren't paying or trading for information. After Dorss handed back their Identi-cards, the Jedi pair denied Dorss's offer for living accommodations. Once Vult had completed the inspection of the ''Shadow'', he reported to Dorss that all items on the ship corresponded with the categorical limits. The Lieutenant then allowed the Skywalkers through so they could visit the Baran Do, with Ben expressing frustration to his father that the two Kel Dor had seemingly pretended to not know who Luke was.<ref name="OC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This is worse than traveling incognito. They acted like they'd never heard of you.''"<br />"''You've been around, Ben. Wasn't that much nicer than arriving somewhere and finding that everyone is trying to shoot you?|Ben and Luke Skywalker, on Dorss and Vult|<ref name="OC" />}}
As a Kel Dor, Dorss was rather thin, bald, and had [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that were intelligent and [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like in appearance. During his talk with Luke Skywalker, Dorss was cordial, but behaved like he was completely unaware of the identity of the high profile [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Ben Skywalker believed from Dorss's gestures that Dorss had interpreted Luke denying accommodations as proof that celebrities were tight with their money, which irritated Ben.<ref name="OC" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|All personal effects within categorical limits. Enjoy your stay on Dorin.|Dorss, to Luke Skywalker, speaking unaccented Basic after speaking Kel Dor|<ref name="OC" />}}
Dorss was able to [[Language/Legends|speak]] his native [[Kel Dor (language)/Legends|Kel Dor]], as well as speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] without any accent.<ref name="OC" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Identi-cards, please.|Dorss, to Luke and Ben Skywalker.|<ref name="OC" />}}
Serving as a customs [[Officer/Legends|officer]] with his partner, Sergeant Vult, Dorss used a card reader to read the [[Identichip/Legends|identicards]] of the people he checked. He wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Robe/Legends|robe]] with sky-blue and black patterns on it. Additionally, Dorss used a [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]<ref name="OC" /> to protect him from [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]], [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]], and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], which were fatal to a Kel Dor.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dorss appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', a novel written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="OC" />
